description:
Reproduced 2026-09-14 at main f26264572 on run and interp:

    def g() when 1 > 0, do: 11
    def g(), do: 22
    def main(), do: g()

thread 'main' panicked at src/compiler2/artifact.rs:1096:5: dispatch plan requires inputs {0} but has only 0 semantic input(s). Removing the guard compiles and runs.

Cause: every guard question rides on a carrier subject that is input 0 (src/dispatch_matrix/pattern.rs:529-532); when input_count is 0 the producer mints an extra input subject with ordinal 0, and required_dispatch_input_ordinals charges it. Keying silently drops it (mask.get_mut -> None). No fixture covers a zero-arity guarded clause.

Closed by construction when the graph records input_demand from a guard's leaves and never charges the carrier. This ticket's commit adds fixtures2/behavior/guard_zero_arity (three doors, oracle twin) so the shape stays pinned.
title: A zero-arity guarded clause panics the compiler on every door
